name: Lying On Of Hands
overview: The concept of 'Lying On Of Hands' in Scripture calls believers to walk in sincerity and purity, as the undefiled are blessed in their obedience to God's law. God deeply hates sin and abominations, highlighting the importance of approaching spiritual practices with reverence and truth. Understanding and hearing God's word is essential, for without it, one cannot truly grasp His purposes or engage rightly in acts such as the laying on of hands.
